text:
Rachel (Marketing): Heads-up team — we’re aiming to publish the launch post + webinar invite tomorrow at 10am PT. Need a quick sync on the changelog link, docs anchors for the new batching + KV cache options, and canary timing. Can we lock by 3pm PT today? :hourglass: 
Mike (Eng Release): Changelog draft is live at https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/1.4.2-draft — finalizing 2 small copy nits now. Will push final link by 2pm PT.
Ashley (DevEx): Awesome. Can you also add the short anchor ids we should link to in the blog? The marketing template needs exact anchors for deep links.
Mike (Eng Release): Added anchors in the draft under each feature, e.g., #adaptive-batching and #kv-cache-prefetch. Example path: https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/1.4.2#adaptive-batching
Rachel (Marketing): Perfect. Can we confirm the docs stable URL (not the draft) for external link? We want no redirects on the press post.
Tom (SRE): Docs will be published to stable at release time. If marketing needs a stable link earlier, we can create a short-term redirect but prefer to point to the canonical URL after the cut.
Ellie (Ops): For canary, ops suggests a 30m early-window (10am PT -> 10:30am verification) then full ramp at 11am PT. Rollback window: hold at 10:30–11:00 for telemetry check.
Hugo (Product): From product POV that works. Also confirm that the webinar CTA references the benchmark deck? We want the benchmark narrative to land in the post and webinar.
Rachel (Marketing): Yes — we'll embed the benchmark highlights and link to the deck. Mike — can you attach the benchmark dataset and a short blurb to the changelog so we can quote numbers?
Mike (Eng Release): Adding a short data note to changelog + pointing to /benchmarks/release-1.4.2.pdf. ETA 1:30pm PT.
Ashley (DevEx): Quick QA ask — marketing will load the demo snippet for the blog. Please confirm the public demo endpoint is ready and unchanged: curl check below.
Ashley (DevEx): ```bash
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/demo/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer PUBLIC_DEMO_KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
Tom (SRE): Verified demo endpoint responds with 200 and current model variant. No plan to change until after rollout.
Rachel (Marketing): Sweet. One last ask — can someone trigger the release-bot to create the final changelog permalink after Mike pushes final? We want the permalink in the announce post and in the webinar slide notes.
Mike (Eng Release): Will push final and ping release-bot.
deploy-bot: Release candidate created: rc-1.4.2. Link: https://releases.redwood.ai/rc-1.4.2.
Mike (Eng Release): Final changelog published: https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/1.4.2 — confirmed anchors are stable.
Rachel (Marketing): Locked — marketing will schedule the blog for 10:00 PT and webinar invite for same day at 11:00 PT. I'll drop the canonical changelog and benchmark deck links in the copy. Thanks all :rocket: 
Ellie (Ops): We'll monitor metrics during 10:00–11:00 and stand by for rollback signal.
Hugo (Product): Sending a quick note to sales with the inbound routing plan after publish. Who owns the inbound lead doc?
Ashley (DevEx): I'll upload the sales one-pager and the gated benchmark deck to the sales drive and DM the link to Hugo.
Rachel (Marketing): Great — timeline: lock links by 3pm PT, final QA pass at 4pm, schedule publish 10am PT tomorrow. Ping here if anything slips. :white_check_mark:
